title_zh: 游戏网站做 SEO：Angular SSR + 93条路由预渲染实战
title_en: SEO for a Game Website: Angular SSR + 93 Prerendered Routes in Practice
desc_zh: 做游戏的人通常不关注 SEO，做 SEO 的人通常不做游戏。但如果你想让人找到你的游戏，两者必须兼顾。这篇文章讲我如何把 Angular 应用的 93 条路由全部预渲染为静态 HTML，部署在 Cloudflare Pages 边缘节点——以及那些坑。
desc_en: Game developers rarely think about SEO; SEO practitioners rarely build games. But if you want people to find your game organically, you have to do both. This article covers how I prerendered all 93 routes as static HTML, deployed on Cloudflare Pages edge nodes, and what went wrong along the way.
content_en:
## Why SEO Matters for a Game Website

Game developers rarely think about SEO. But "sudoku online," "minesweeper free," "puzzle games" — these search terms get hundreds of thousands of searches per day, and the top results are often ancient sites with terrible UX.

That's an opportunity. Ranking in the top 3 for even one of these terms means a steady stream of free, high-intent traffic — people who are actively looking for exactly what you built.

But SEO requires one thing: **search engine crawlers must be able to read your page content.**

SPAs (single-page applications) are problematic here — crawlers get a nearly empty HTML shell, with all content rendered by JavaScript. Google claims it can execute JavaScript, but rendering delays and uncertainty make SPA SEO unreliable.

Solution: **SSR (Server-Side Rendering) or SSG (Static Site Generation).**

---

## Why SSG Over Pure SSR

My platform has two page types:

1. **Static content pages** — game descriptions, blog posts, about pages. Content changes rarely. Perfect for prerendering.
2. **Dynamic game pages** — the actual game UI. Needs WebSocket, real-time state. Can't be fully static.

For type 1: SSG — render at build time, serve from CDN, instant load, great SEO.
For type 2: The page shell can be prerendered; the game logic runs client-side after hydration.

Angular's `RenderMode` can be configured per route:

```typescript
export const serverRoutes: ServerRoute[] = [
    { path: ':lang/blog/:id',   renderMode: RenderMode.Server },      // dynamic
    { path: ':lang/games/**',   renderMode: RenderMode.Prerender },   // static shell
    { path: '**',               renderMode: RenderMode.Prerender },   // everything else
];
```

---

## 93 Routes: The Breakdown

- 14 games × 2 languages (zh/en) = 28 game routes
- Blog list pages × 2 = 2
- Static pages (about, leaderboard, achievements) × 2 ≈ 30
- Game tutorial/rules pages × 2 ≈ 20
- Home, lobby × 2 = 4
- Other = 9

**Total: 93 routes**, all prerendered to static HTML at build time.

---

## SSR Pitfall: Browser APIs Don't Exist on the Server

Angular SSR runs in Node.js — no `window`, no `localStorage`, no `WebSocket`. Direct usage crashes the server.

Solution: wrap all browser APIs:

```typescript
export function isBrowser(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined';
}

// During SSR, WebSocket connections are skipped entirely
const ws = isBrowser() ? new WebSocket(url) : null;
```

HTTP requests during SSR are short-circuited with a no-op interceptor — pages render from static data or empty state, then hydrate with real data after the client loads.

---

## OG Tags for Social Sharing

SEO covers search engines; OG tags handle social sharing previews — the cards that appear when you share a link in WeChat, Telegram, or Twitter.

```typescript
this.seoService.setMeta({
    title:       'Online Sudoku — Puzzle PK',
    description: '4 difficulty levels, real-time PK battles, free to play',
    ogImage:     'https://puzzlepk.com/assets/og/sudoku.png',
    ogUrl:       'https://puzzlepk.com/en/games/sudoku',
});
```

---

## Results

- 93 static HTML files, each with full readable content
- Rankings for puzzle-related keywords improving steadily
- LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) < 1.5s from Cloudflare CDN
- Social share cards displaying correctly in WeChat and Telegram
